ruleBookInfo.init:
<js>(function() {
    var scripts = java.getStringList("//script[@type='text/javascript']/text()");
    var content = scripts.size() > 2 ? scripts.get(2) : "";
    var jsonMatch = content.match(/JSON\.parse\(['\"]([\s\S]*?)['\"]\)/);
    if (!jsonMatch) return "";
    
    var jsonStr = jsonMatch[1].replace(/\\u0022/g, '"')
                              .replace(/\\\//g, '/')
                              .replace(/\\\\/g, '\\');
    var data = JSON.parse(jsonStr);
    
    cache.putMemory("music_id", data.mp3_id);
    cache.putMemory("play_id", data.play_id);
    java.log("data: " + JSON.stringify(data));

    return data.mp3_cover;
})()</js>
